sources.title: Tino Rossi 1934 - On n’aime qu’une fois (You Love Only Once) — YouTube
sources.researchNote: The uploader identifies Tino Rossi with Orchestre de Tango Rafaelo and Columbia 1934. BnF independently catalogues this title with the same singer and orchestra on Columbia DF 1622, but the upload does not show the disc label or catalogue number; it is therefore retained as access evidence rather than treated as a visual verification of the pressing.
